display.title: Episode 120: The Forbidden Road, Chapter 1 (Rosh Chodesh Nissan)
display.summary_short: On Rosh Chodesh Nissan, Uncle Yossi teaches about controlling one's temper and begins the story of rich Reb Beryl, whose anger leads him onto a forbidden road.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Rosh Chodesh Nissan 5744. Uncle Yossi opens with listeners' mail: a refuah shleimah, birthday wishes, and an invitation to write about Purim. After the Hakochainik march and the sponsor, he teaches that learning Torah must lead to action and good midos, and that the Sages compare losing one's temper to idol worship. A brother and sister recite the Shema. The story, 'Reb Beryl Learns a Lesson', tells of a wealthy, learned but stingy and boastful man with a quick temper. When his son's melamed teaches that wealth and poverty are in Hashem's hands, Reb Beryl angrily sends him away. Walking off his anger, he wanders onto a street where Jews are forbidden on Sundays, and an officer tricks him into signing away all his property. Penniless, he goes to his Rebbe for advice, and the chapter ends there. The show closes with a Rosh Chodesh Nissan talk on Moshiach, the clouds of Heaven and the children leading the march out of golus.
display.lesson: Learning must lead to good deeds; never lose your temper, and remember that wealth and poverty are in Hashem's hands.
